title: Calegari and Walker, Surface subgroups from linear programming
body:
## The reference

Danny Calegari and Alden Walker, *Surface subgroups from linear programming*,
Duke Mathematical Journal **164** (2015), no. 5, 933-972.
arXiv:1212.2618. doi:10.1215/00127094-2877511

From the abstract: certain classes of graphs of free groups contain surface
subgroups, including groups with positive b_2 obtained by doubling free groups
along collections of subgroups, and groups obtained by random ascending HNN
extensions of free groups. The unit ball in the Gromov norm in dimension 2 of a
double of a free group along a collection of subgroups is a finite-sided rational
polyhedron, and every rational class is virtually represented by an extremal
surface subgroup. The results are obtained by a mixture of combinatorial,
geometric and linear programming techniques.

## Why it is relevant

This is the source of the train-track scl technology. Several statements recorded
in this project are theorems modulo that machinery: true, and provable by a
competent person who knows this paper, but with the derivation not written out
anywhere. Such records cite this paper and are marked as having no proof written
out, which is an accurate description of their state and an open invitation.
